title: Set up Claude Code with Set-up Info
done: That is it: install the plugin once, and update it whenever the app says it is out of date.

steps.caption: Set-up Info is in the garnet-scoping menu on macOS, and in the Help menu on Ubuntu.
It opens a window of text to copy. Here it is.
Run its first two commands in a terminal. They install the garnet-scoping plugin, which brings the watcher, the board tools and the rules into every session.
From then on, your signals reach every new session, and each has the board tools.
